notes.title: Cats lost in time need your help in Pine Studio's Cats in Time!
notes.content:
[b]Cats in Time [/b]is a relaxing puzzle game where you explore 3D dioramas, solve puzzles, and save cats lost in time. The game is a cute mix of room escape and hidden object games, but with cats! 

[h1][b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1599880/Cats_in_Time/?utm_source=summerpaws]Cats in Time by Pine Studio is out now![/url][/b][/h1]

Cats are good at hiding, perfect even. Purrrfect, even. You know how difficult it can be to find them all. in Cats in Time you'll have to look for ten missing cats in each level, for a total of 290 cats. You'll solve mechanical puzzles to open all kinds of hiding spots: boxes, doors, roofs, holes, cars and so on.
